flags.why: The historical word means resplendent, rather than arrogant, according to the [Nôm dictionary](https://nomfoundation.org/nom-tools/Tu-Dien-Chu-Nom-Dan_Giai?nom=%F0%B1%BB%8C&radicalNum=123&strokeCt=7&uiLang=vn).

flags.fix: Mình mặc áo giáp quang hoa dẫy dàng. = Clad in brilliantly shining armor.
